content: The simplified German side of the parallel data together with the monolingual-only data can be used for automatic readability assessment. The parallel data in the corpus is useful both for deriving rules for a rule-based text simplification system in a data-driven manner and for training a data-driven machine translation system. A data augmentation technique such as back-translation BIBREF18 can be applied to the monolingual-only data to arrive at additional (synthetic) parallel data.
